::: {#def-pattern-events}

#### Events at a covariate pattern

The number of **events** at the [covariate pattern](#def-covariate-pattern) $\vpredvar^{(k)}$ is the sum of the binary outcomes over its [replicates](#def-replicates):

$$
\nevents_k = \sum_{i:\, \vpredvar_\iobs = \vpredvar^{(k)}} \outvar_\iobs,
$$

so $0 \le \nevents_k \le \nreps_k$.

:::
